boundaries.enrollment: direct wall from image decode through fresh persistent insertion into a 55-identity gallery (55 to 56); restoration excluded
boundaries.recognition: direct wall from image decode through actual gallery search and four-state decision; capture failures retained separately
boundaries.search: actual FaceGallery.search including normalization, rebuilding matrix, sorting and metadata lookup; not a cached matrix microkernel
boundaries.decision: actual OpenSetDecisionEngine.evaluate_scores only; instance construction excluded
boundaries.excluded: model loading, warmup, browser/UI transfer, webcam capture, network/RTSP and camera FPS

repetitions_note: Repeated calls on fixed inputs measure latency, not independent accuracy samples; warm CPU and filesystem-cache conditions.
